procedures.title: Fortress Anchor Fluke Adjustment
preconditions: Anchor must be on deck or stable surface
steps: Select desired angle between 32° and 45° based on bottom conditions
procedures.expected_outcome: Anchor flukes set at optimal angle for bottom conditions with up to 400% increased holding power in soft mud

procedures.title: Anchor Dismantling Procedure
preconditions: Anchor must be clean and dry
procedures.expected_outcome: Anchor disassembled into compact storage configuration

procedures.title: Shackle Installation
procedures.expected_outcome: Shackle properly secured to anchor within working load limits
